title: Reviewable memory sources from archives, family posts or places

sourceMode.title: Source
sourceMode.description: Choose historical archives, explicit public posts, a public place, or bounded educational object context.

topicKey.title: Object topic
topicKey.description: Object mode retrieves short attributed passages from fixed educational pages and Wikipedia articles, plus public-domain Library of Congress photos, for one topic key (kite, flowers, oak, hills, bench, radio …; see src/knowledge.mjs). No family words or caller-supplied URLs.

topicKeys.title: Object topics (batch)
topicKeys.description: Object mode: several topic keys at once, for the app's saved copy. Up to 150.

query.title: Public place or landmark (place mode)
query.description: A public place name and town, 3–120 characters. Never include a private address or family story.

postUrls.title: Public Instagram photo posts (social mode)
postUrls.description: One to three public photo-post URLs you have permission to use. No profiles, reels or private content.

permissionConfirmed.title: I have permission to use these public posts
permissionConfirmed.description: Required in social mode before retrieving public photo posts.

place.title: Public place name
place.description: A city, neighborhood or public landmark. Do not send private family stories or addresses.

yearFrom.title: From year
yearFrom.description: Earliest year for archive results; not used in social or place mode.

yearTo.title: To year
yearTo.description: Latest year for archive results; must not precede the earliest year.

terms.title: Optional public search terms
terms.description: Short public archive search terms, without private family information.

maxItems.title: Maximum references
maxItems.description: Maximum archive references to retrieve, from one to eight.
